name: cli-discord-presence
description: Run CLI tools with Discord Rich Presence.

scripts.build: npm run bundle && pkg build/cli.cjs --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-linux-arm64,node18-macos-x64,node18-macos-arm64,node18-win-x64 --out-path dist
scripts.build:linux: npm run bundle && pkg build/cli.cjs --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-linux-arm64 --out-path dist
scripts.build:macos: npm run bundle && pkg build/cli.cjs --targets node18-macos-x64,node18-macos-arm64 --out-path dist
scripts.build:windows: npm run bundle && pkg build/cli.cjs --targets node18-win-x64 --out-path dist
